Application Documentation
=========================

The Ntando's News application is organised into Django models, forms,
serializers, permissions, web views, and REST API views.

REST API
--------

The REST API module provides endpoints for articles, newsletters,
publishers, users, subscriptions, and approved article records.

.. automodule:: newsapp.views

Permissions
-----------

The permissions module restricts actions according to the authenticated
user's role.

.. automodule:: newsapp.permissions
